svg.title: CartShelf
svg.desc: A native Mac app for your M64 and Chromatic game libraries. Three original pixel cartridges sit on a shelf beside the CartShelf name.
svg.metadata: Original CartShelf branding and manually authored pixel letterforms. GPL-3.0-only. No external fonts or images.

g.aria-label: YOUR GAMES. YOUR SAVES. YOUR SHELF.
Three pixel cartridges on a shelf
